summary.intent: Execute gap closure plans for Phase 19.2 (IPFS upload performance optimization), then plan new gap closure plans after verification found 2 remaining issues.
summary.outcome: Phase 19.2 executed successfully (2/2 plans complete) with concurrent pin orchestration and pebbleds datastore configured, but verification found 2 gaps (mismatched baseline environments, missing PERF-09 requirement); gap closure planning was then initiated.

repo: Phase 19.2 IPFS upload optimization uses Promise.allSettled to parallelize IPNS publish and folder metadata update steps
Kubo pebbleds datastore requires a fresh volume (delete existing ipfs_data volume) when switching from default datastore
Pre/post baselines were captured in different environments (staging vs localhost) with different client counts (10 vs 5), making performance comparisons non-definitive
REQUIREMENTS.md only goes up to PERF-08; PERF-09 referenced in plans is missing from the requirements definitions and traceability table
workflow: Wave-based parallel execution: Wave 1 (SDK concurrent orchestration) must complete before Wave 2 (infrastructure + baselines) to establish the code baseline
Checkpoint plans (autonomous: false) pause execution for human infrastructure actions — in this case redeploying Docker stack on remote host
Git push to remote was needed mid-execution so the user could pull updated docker-compose.yml to the target host (192.168.133.114)
Gap closure mode (--gaps) skips research and reads VERIFICATION.md directly to generate targeted fix plans numbered sequentially after existing plans (03+)

friction: Pre/post baselines were captured under different conditions (different environments, different client counts), making the performance improvement claim non-definitive — required a gap closure cycle
Infrastructure checkpoint required pushing branch to remote mid-execution so user could deploy to 192.168.133.114 — a manual handoff step in an otherwise automated pipeline
open_items: PERF-09 requirement needs to be added to REQUIREMENTS.md and traceability table
Matched-condition staging load test needed: run pre/post baselines in same environment with same client count to confirm p95 improvement numbers
